agents.claim: The route needs obstacle, proof, reversal, and earned payoff.

exploration_routes.name: Parallel Routes To Same Home
exploration_routes.story_lens: Separate public lives become one chosen private home through small visible crossings.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Everyone who loves their person can recognize the strange tenderness of realizing separate ordinary years were quietly leading somewhere.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The obstacle is the invisible loneliness and near-misses before two people know each other: life keeps them separate until a tiny crossing makes the world smaller.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu carries expressive movement, red scarf/bag color, and the first curious turn across the city route.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv is not passive fate; he slows at the crossing, offers steady hand/rail closeness, steadies Aachu on the escalator, and walks the same path with her.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: overhead almosts -> separate city routes -> one crosswalk -> hand touch in transit -> escalator side-hug -> joined hands on one path
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: What first looks like cinematic fate becomes active choosing and daily steadiness.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: The final thesis is sendable to a partner because it turns fate/timing into a simple relationship mirror: we had different stories before we became home.

The story should show overhead public spaces, separate routes, a street crossing, two hands in transit, an escalator closeness beat, and finally hand-holding on the same path. Preserve the concept of parallel lives becoming one chosen home, but rewrite all on-image copy into original A Story of Two language. Make it cinematic, novelistic, premium watercolor-and-ink, with Aachu/Zuv identity references, mostly distant faces but consistent hair, posture, wardrobe, and relationship energy.
